Bitcoin ETFs Draw $66 Million Inflows, Ether Funds Post Small Outflow Bitcoin ETFs Draw $66 Million as Ether Funds Post Small Outflow U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $66.19 million in net inflows on Sept. 29, according to SoSoValue, led by BlackRock’s IBIT with $51.09 million. Spot Ether ETFs, meanwhile, posted a modest $2.81 million net outflow, even as Grayscale’s Ethereum Mini Trust (ETH) attracted $12.83 million. — link

HSBC, Hong Kong’s Largest Bank, Names Stablecoin ‘RedCoin’ HSBC, Hong Kong’s largest bank and one of the city’s three note-issuing banks, has named its forthcoming stablecoin HSBC RedCoin, with an initial rollout focused on person-to-person (P2P) transfers and person-to-merchant (P2M) payments before expanding to corporate and institutional use cases. The bank also released a survey of more than 1,000 Hong Kong customers, finding that 74% could identify at least one stablecoin use case. Digital-asset trading and tokenized investments ranked first at 57%, followed by P2P transfers at 53%, while cross-border remittances and merchant payments each stood at 52%. — link

Highlight Clip: THORChain's "Decentralization" Faces Scrutiny After Bitget Asks It to Block Hackers THORChain's "Decentralization" Faces Scrutiny After Bitget Asks It to Block Hackers Bitget CEO Gracy Chen asked THORChain to refuse service to publicly identified attacker addresses, saying decentralization should not be a shield for facilitating stolen funds. THORChain emphasized that its network is permissionless. In May 2026, an attack on one of THORChain’s vaults caused approximately $10.7 million in losses. Automatic safeguards and coordinated action by node operators subsequently halted the network. Co-founder Chad Barraford later discussed ideas for anomaly detection and emergency pauses on a podcast, outlining security checks and asset migration procedures before trading could resume. While halting a network is not the same as freezing specific addresses, the dispute raises a question: Under what circumstances should a decentralized protocol intervene when stolen funds originate from an external platform? — link

OKX Releases 47th Proof-of-Reserves Report OKX, one of the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchanges, reported 139,865 BTC in user assets in its 47th proof-of-reserves report, up 4.07% from its Aug. 11 snapshot, an increase of 5,466 BTC. User Ether holdings rose 3.49% to 1.786 million ETH, while USDT holdings increased 4.62% to 8.49 billion tokens. The Sept. 8 snapshot showed reserve ratios of 109% for BTC, 101% for ETH and 105% for USDT. — link
